spanish: Y en el día el octavo tomará dos corderos íntegros, y cordera una hija de su año, íntegra, y tres décimas sólet, minjá amasada en el aceite, y log uno de aceite.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the untranslated lemma sólet.
Common noun left as the untranslated lemma minjá.
Qal passive participle of the mix lemma is rendered as kneading, a manner the token does not license.
Common noun left as the untranslated lemma log.
Unmarked de only joins the juxtaposed measure and oil.

notes: Day, taker, animals, year idiom, tenths, and oil match the tokens.
